name: call-us-section
title: Call us section
description: A phone-first contact block for businesses people ring: the number large, whether the line is open now, and a callback alternative.
docs: Pass the phone number, a title and, to say whether the line is answered, the hours (ranges of days with an opening and a closing time on the 24-hour clock) and the time zone the business keeps, such as Europe/Amsterdam. Open or closed is worked out on the reader's clock in that zone after the page has mounted, so the server never claims either: until then the status is an empty line of the same height. Pass now to pin it for a test or a screenshot. The status says Open now, until 17:30 or Closed, opens Monday at 08:00 in the reader's locale, with a dot and words, never colour alone. The number is a tap-to-call link sized for a thumb, made of its digits and a leading plus; its size follows the section's width and the length of the number, so it stays on one line on a phone. afterHours adds a second number that stands out, with a Use this one now tag, the moment the line closes, and alternative adds a Prefer we call you? link to a callback form. The whole week sits in a disclosure with today marked, under a heading one level below the section's own, and says which time zone it is in; defaultOpen starts it open. A range must not cross midnight: split it at 24:00. labels translates every fixed word.
